prompt.en: Who was the first French-Canadian prime minister since Confederation?
prompt.fr: Qui a été le premier premier ministre canadien-français depuis la Confédération?

explanation.en: No French Canadian had led the country since 1867 until Sir Wilfrid Laurier did. He pushed hard to bring newcomers to the West. You can see his face on the five-dollar bill.
explanation.fr: Aucun Canadien français n'avait dirigé le pays depuis 1867 avant sir Wilfrid Laurier. Il a tout fait pour attirer des nouveaux venus dans l'Ouest. On voit son visage sur le billet de cinq dollars.

source.quote: Sir Wilfrid Laurier became the first French-Canadian prime minister since Confederation and encouraged immigration to the West. His portrait is on the $5 bill.

verification.evidence: Sir Wilfrid Laurier became the first French-Canadian prime minister since Confederation and encouraged immigration to the West. His portrait is on the $5 bill.
